note: CR 189 · AgAPI → Sasha POST /api/booking/keep/resolve. The body is canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces, UTF-8) and x-agapi-signature = hex HMAC-SHA256(SASHA_KEEP_RESOLVE_SECRET, those exact bytes). Sasha opens the reference ONLY when: the account is Sasha's own AgAPI account; the movement is the person's; the member is on that movement; the reference is that member's — else 403 {rule} and a log line, nothing opened.
